meta.title: Victoria Sergienko — a professional retoucher
meta.description: Color correction and skin retouching for wedding, family and personal photoshoots. Clean color, consistent results, confidence in every series.

prices.title: Clear prices per photo
prices.intro: I have an individual approach for each client, so the final cost is determined personally. The minimum order is 10 photos.

process.title: Calm, clear and comfortable at every stage
process.intro: I know how difficult it can be to trust your photographs to someone else. That is why my workflow is built to be simple and transparent.

portfolio.title: See the difference
portfolio.hint: Drag the slider to compare the original and the result.

contact.title: Leave your details and I will get back to you
contact.text: I will answer all your questions. Tell me what you need, how many photos and the deadline. For color I need RAW files, for skin retouching JPEG or TIFF. A reference of the desired result saves time.

form.name: Name
form.consent: By clicking “Send” you agree to the processing of your personal data.
form.thanksText: I will get back to you soon and answer all your questions.
